description:
A GUI client for gRPC and REST APIs with innovative features for environments, authorizations and more.

Kreya is a GUI client for gRPC, REST and WebSocket APIs. It makes calling APIs easy! Supported features:
- Kreya stores the files locally in JSON format for easy git-syncing (or any other syncing software)
- Unary, client-streaming, server-streaming and duplex requests (gRPC)
- Supports HTTP/2 and HTTP/3
- Authentication configurations - declare once, use everywhere
- Environment support combined with a powerful templating language
- Directory settings (ex. define the endpoint or authentication once for all requests)
- Scripting and tests
- kreyac, the Kreya CLI
- Server reflection (gRPC)
- OpenAPI import (REST)
- And more!
Features
- Core: add configurable timeouts for all technologies
- Core: general directory settings across all technologies
- Core: keymap support
- Core: simplify project creation dialog
- Core: support request and response compression and show size in UI
- GraphQL: show subscription message sizes
- gRPC: show request/response size
- REST: show streamed response message sizes
- Scripting: add non-blocking kreya.wait and deprecate kreya.sleep
- UI: add context menu typeahead search
- UI: auth type selection searchable
- UI: improve settings screen layout
- UI: improve timing tab
- UI: mask secret values
- UI: support context menu keyboard navigation
- UI: support home and end keys when navigating lists with the keyboard
- WebSocket: show message size
Bug Fixes
- Auth: handle templated redirect uris in oidc auths
- Auth: prevent crash when closing the OAuth login window
- Auth: show OIDC refresh token errors
- Auth: store and revert auth details correctly, save on tab switch
- Core: allow colons in request path first segment
- Core: do not include personal information in report error infos
- Core: fix a rare bug that resulted in not all responses shown
- Core: fix crash when modifying running operations
- Core: fixed a bug where opening multiple projects could lead to crashes
- Core: handle git worktree project roots
- Core: handle invoker script cancellation when kreya.sleep is running
- Core: importer with warnings does succeed and informs the user about the warnings
- Core: prevent regex timeout when parsing mime types
- Core: propagate operation auth cancellation
- Core: show importer failure status
- GraphQL: correct badge on params tab
- gRPC: complete calls with cancelled status
- gRPC: prevent request size flash
- Importers: prevent crash when importing OpenAPI byte values
- Linux: improve snap release
- Linux: update Snap runtime
- macOS: cancel native terminate to avoid abort during Cmd+Q
- macOS: fix a rare crash when running long invoker scripts
- macOS: fix a rare macOS SSL bug when resuming TLS sessions
- macOS: pin QUIC bottles to a specific version reproducibly
- REST: preserve response file names from content disposition
- Scripting: keep cancelled invoker scripts cancelled
- UI: allow hoisted assets in Angular dev server
- UI: catch fatal errors in native UI entry points
- UI: commit renaming settings entry after successful save
- UI: display accurate response duration
- UI: do not display UI error dialog on frontend errors
- UI: handle duplicate default settings tour anchor
- UI: handle empty recent project search
- UI: handle host-only URLs in REST path
- UI: handle inaccessible project files
- UI: hide json path without response
- UI: if a running operation is opened show correct state
- UI: keep selected operation filter visible when its count drops to 0
- UI: load large operation history entries without freezing
- UI: make sure axis labels in timing do not overlap
- UI: only place history tabs next to the currently selected operation
- UI: open external links from editors in the default browser
- UI: open links from response previews in the default browser
- UI: reduce layout shifting in response timing header
- UI: reset typeahead search with escape
- UI: save operations, scripts and collections before duplication
- UI: show hints for filtered operation results
- UI: show running state in operation list for scripts and collections
- UI: show single unchanged diff lines
- UI: store and revert certificate options correctly
- UI: support paths in streamed responses
- UI: tabs rarely tracked the selected tab incorrectly
- WebSocket: show individual response message sizes
- Windows: correctly update all files during update process
